sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "status"."station_id" AS e, AVG(("status"."bikes_available" - "status"."docks_available")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "status" GROUP BY "status"."station_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
